title: Massive 3 bedroom home close to downtown!
description:
Take advantage of 4 beds in this spacious townhome only 10 min from the airport & 15min from Downtown Nashville, Broadway, & more! The unit features 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms & private garage. 

HIGHLIGHTS
- 4 Beds (3 King)
- Kitchen & Bathroom Essentials
- Private Garage
- Washer & Dryer w/ Tide Pods
- Complimentary Wi-Fi!
- Bag Drop Off, Early Check-In & Late Check-Out Options
- Smart Lock w/ Unique Access Code

The space
LEVEL ONE
The first floor features the entrance, laundry facilities & office area.

LEVEL TWO
The second floor features a kitchen, living room w/ pull out couch, dining + 1 bedroom w/ KING Bed & 1 full bathroom

LEVEL THREE
The third level features two bedrooms with each featuring a KING bed, each with their own ensuite bathroom.

PARKING
The attached garage can accommodate two vehicles.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home except for a locked owner's closet. They'll receive a four-digit access code before arrival to enter the unit through our Schlage Encode smart lock. Additionally, there will be an onsite lockbox accessible in case of a smart lock failure.

Other things to note
We are the following minutes away from these destinations by car:
🤠 2 minutes to Nashboro Golf Club
🤠 5 minutes to Hamilton Creek Recreation Area
🤠 20 minutes from Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, Nissan Stadium & Bridgestone Arena
🤠 20 minutes from Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills Mall
🤠 10 minutes from the Nashville International Airport (BNA)
🤠 20 minutes from Geodis Park (Home to Nashville SC)
🤠 25 minutes from Belmont University & Vanderbilt University
To help protect the home from potential damage or parties, we kindly ask guests to choose between a fully refundable $250 deposit or a $59 damage protection policy. Thank you for helping us keep the space safe and enjoyable for everyone! We are extremely excited  for the chance to host you and your group!
